mainText:
Good evening. Weather in Prishtina: 10 degrees now, light rain. Next 24 hours: high 10, low 5.

Tesla will invest three billion euros in Germany to build its largest European vehicle factory, a move aimed at strengthening its presence as German car makers face job cuts and plant closures.

Protesters, including students and young people, gathered again on Sunday in front of Albania's prime-ministerial building, blocking the road as their months-long demonstration against the government continued.

Kosovo's Security Force carried out a mortar-firing exercise in the Biza area of Albania, part of a program to enhance the operational capacity of its Ground Forces Support Command.

Lutfi Dalipi scored a decisive goal for Vaduz against Lausanne, earning the "Player of the Match" award and helping the young Kosovar secure a crucial point in the Swiss top-flight league.

Chinese smartphone maker Honor announced it is developing a new phone equipped with a 13,500-mAh battery, continuing its push to offer devices with exceptionally long battery life.
